subject: [Initial Ask] SOC 2 Type II + SIG/CAIQ orientation and minimal evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@consiliumtech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security@consiliumtech.com
Date: 2027-11-28T10:15:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ intake — next steps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro call this morning. We are starting the procurement security review and need your SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12-month period plus a few clarifications around evidence and supporting artifacts. We also collect SIG/CAIQ answers for our questionnaire. To keep this low-friction, can you confirm the following:  

- Do you have a recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a short bridge letter or management assertion?
- Do you have an evidence manifest or index we can use to request items (logs, retention policy, IAM screenshots, backup policy)?
- Preferred transfer method (SFTP, secure Drive, or Box)?
- Are there any redaction constraints we should be aware of?

If possible, a minimal bundle with the report + a one-page bridge letter + an evidence manifest would let us triage quickly. Our target procurement deadline is 2027-12-10.

Thanks,
Teresa
Security Lead, Consilium Tech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@consiliumtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T09:06:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ intake — next steps

Teresa —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide the Type II report and a concise bridge letter. Quick answers up-front:  

- Report: SOC 2 Type II (controls relevant to Security and Availability) covering 2026-11-01 through 2027-10-31. PDF ready.
- Bridge letter: draft attached; we typically provide a one-page management statement that explains periods, exceptions, and scope.
- Evidence manifest: we'll share a CSV index mapping common SIG/CAIQ topics to artifact names and suggested redaction guidance.
- Transfer: SFTP is our preferred automated route for large evidence sets; for the report + bridge letter we can share a secure Drive link.
- Redaction: we redact personal data and customer identifiers by default; redaction rules are documented in the manifest.

Proposed minimal bundle (what to share immediately to unblock review):  
1) SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (report)
2) Redwood_bridge_letter_2027.docx (one pager)
3) evidence-manifest.csv (index with artifact owners & expected file names)
4) sftp-instructions.txt (credentials/paths)

I copied Marissa (legal & contracts) and Monica (security ops) to help with any follow-up evidence asks. If that bundle works, we'll push the Drive link by EOD today and can open an SFTP window for deeper artifacts.

Sample one-line reply you can use internally if you need a fast approval: 
"Consilium — we received Redwood's SOC2 Type II report and bridge letter; SFTP access for evidence will be shared by 11/29. Can you confirm the list of SIG/CAIQ questions you want prioritized?"

-Karthik
Director, GTM Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@consiliumtech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Bryan Hsu <bryan.hsu@swancloud.com>, security@consiliumtech.com
Date: 2027-11-29T12:48:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ intake — next steps

Karthik — thank you. The bundle sounds good. A few clarifications from our side:  

- SIG/CAIQ scope: we'll prioritize Encryption, IAM, Logging & Monitoring, and Backups for initial triage. We will send the full questionnaire but can accept a partial response set for those domains.
- Evidence cadence: for the initial review, PDFs and screenshots are fine; if we need raw logs we'll request a specific timeframe.
- SFTP access: please provide a short-lived account (7 days) and list of artifact paths in the manifest.
- Bridge letter: please include an explicit statement about any control exceptions during the audit period and whether Royalty/3rd-party subcontractors were in-scope.

Can you share the Drive link and manifest when ready? If you want, send a short suggested SIG/CAIQ prioritization so we can mark the items we'll review first.

Best,
Teresa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@consiliumtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ intake — next steps

Teresa —

Thanks again. Drive link and the minimal bundle are now available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwoodSOC2 (link expires 2028-01-15). Attachments included in the manifest are: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, bridge-letter-draft.docx, evidence-manifest.csv and sftp-instructions.txt. The manifest column headers are: topic, artifact_name, owner, path, suggested_redaction, sample_screenshot.  

Quick SIG/CAIQ prioritization (we recommend these artifacts first):
- Encryption: kms-keys.md, network-architecture.png, db-encryption-policy.pdf
- IAM: iam-policy-snapshot.json (redacted), admin-list.xlsx, sso-config-screen.pdf
- Logging/Monitoring: observability-retention.pdf, sample-alerts-export.zip (metadata only)
- Backups: backup-policy.pdf, last-successful-backup.txt

Bridge-letter notes: the bridge letter explicitly states the audit period, systems in-scope, and that Redwood had no control exceptions that impacted availability controls. It also notes one minor procedural finding from Q1 2027 (remediated). If you prefer a signed management assertion we can escalate.

If you need any artifact redacted differently, call out the manifest row and we will provide a redaction copy. For SIG/CAIQ answers, Monica has prepared concise responses for the prioritized domains; we can dump those into the manifest as short text responses to accelerate triage.

Next steps suggested:
1) Consilium confirms prioritized SIG/CAIQ sections (Encryption, IAM, Logging, Backups).
2) Consilium performs first-pass review on the bundle.
3) If additional artifacts are requested, open an SFTP ticket referencing HS-004523; we'll enable a 7-day window.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — hoping this clears the procurement path before your 12/10 deadline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments (as referenced): redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 executive summary), bridge-letter-draft.docx (management bridge draft), evidence-manifest.csv (artifact index), sftp-instructions.txt (temporary credentials instructions)
